newsitem.title: USA: Royal Grip to merge with FM Precision.
newsitem.headline: Royal Grip to merge with FM Precision.

text.p: Royal Grip Inc Friday said in signed a letter of intent to combine with FM Precision Golf Corp, a privately-held golf club shaft manufacturer based in Torrington, Connecticut.
While specific terms and conditions of the transaction were not disclosed, FM Precision shareholders will obtain a majority interest in Royal Grip.

The company said the board of directors of the combined company will consist of nine persons, three designees from the existing Royal Grip board, including Danny Edwards, current chairman and chief executive of Royal Grip, and Bob Burg, current president of Royal Grip, and the current board of directors of FM Precision: Richard Johnston, Chris Johnston, David Johnston, Ray Minella, Ken Warren and Ron Chalmers.

The currently proposed management of the holding company will be: Richard Johnston, chairman, Danny Edwards, vice chairman and Chris Johnston, president and chief executive officer. Ron Chalmers will be executive vice president of the holding company and will continue as president and chief executive of FM Precision Golf Manufacturing Corp and Robert Burg II, will be executive vice president of the holding company and president and chief executive of the golf grip and headwear subsidiaries.
